source.method: Word-by-word review by Claude (November 2026); no automatic links

1:5.note: 'Sin of Judah' for 'high places of Judah'.

1:6.note: 'House of the field' for 'heap of the field'.

1:7.note: 'Her idols' for 'her hires'; infinitive-absolute style doubling.

1:11.note: 'Went out naked and was not ashamed' rearranges the clauses.

1:14.note: Place names Moresheth and Achzib translated.

2:1.note: Syriac adds 'what they devised'; 'lift their hands to God' for 'power of their hand'.

2:4.note: 'With a cord he divides'; 'to me' not rendered.

2:6.note: 'Do not weep tears' for 'do not preach'.

3:6.note: 'Sun will set' for 'sun will go down'.

4:1.note: 'It will be' and 'it' not rendered; Syriac adds 'all'.

4:7.note: 'Scattered' and 'far' for 'lame' and 'cast off'; Syriac adds 'and in Jerusalem'.

4:13.note: Second 'I will make' not rendered; 'you will devote' for 'I will devote'.

5:5.note: 'In his anger' for 'in her gates'; 'that he not come' for 'when he comes'.

5:9.note: Initial 'and it shall be' not rendered.

6:7.note: Questions as negative statements; 'my firstborn is iniquity to me' (ܠܝ carries the suffix of פשעי); copulas plus.

6:8.note: 'Be ready to walk after' for 'walk humbly with'.

6:9.note: 'Instruction to those who fear his name' for 'wisdom sees your name'.

6:11.note: 'How shall they be justified' for 'shall I be pure'.

6:15.note: Syriac adds 'you will tread'; 'wine' not rendered.

7:3.note: Free: 'their hands do good for evil and do no good'; Syriac adds 'gold' and 'says'.

7:4.note: 'Like a garment the moth eats' replaces 'straightest is worse than a thorn hedge'; 'house of their weeping'.

7:5.note: 'From your wife' for 'from her who lies in your bosom'.

7:11.note: 'You will be removed' for 'decree will be far'.

7:12.note: 'Strong cities' and 'Tyre' for 'Mazor'; 'mountain' read as 'Mount Hor'.

7:17.note: 'From their paths' for 'from their strongholds'; 'from you' not rendered.

7:18.note: Question rendered as statement ('there is no God like you').
